items.description: Whether an element can go full screen, whether it is, and a toggle: reads the element's own document (a face may run in a frame), follows fullscreenchange so Escape is reflected, and swallows a denied request's rejection. Server-safe.

items.name: core-playback-clock
items.title: Playback Clock
items.description: Where a playing timeline is now, as a tiny external store outside React: playbackPositionAt for the maths, createPlaybackClock advancing on requestAnimationFrame only while subscribed and the document is visible (and stopping at the end of a timeline that does not loop), usePlaybackClock to keep one clock per timeline, and usePlaybackPosition for the one leaf that draws a playhead. Code that writes to a non-React view subscribes directly, so playback never re-renders a face.

items.name: core-scene-shell
items.title: Scene Shell
items.description: The reusable part of an interactive three.js face scene: a WebGL renderer with an unavailable path, resize and on-screen tracking, a 30 fps draw loop that pauses when hidden, tap-to-pick versus drag over named objects, context-loss handling and full disposal, plus DOM label placement over world positions. The scene owns its content and parameters; sound stays with the host's Processor.

items.name: core-console-icons
items.title: Console Icons
items.description: The small stroked glyphs the console controls and module faces share (transport, disclosure, add and remove, dice, menus, help, mute and solo) as one ConsoleIcon component on a 16-unit grid, drawn in currentColor and aria-hidden, so a die in a seed slot and a die in a face header are the same die.

items.name: core-timeline-roll
items.title: Timeline Roll
items.description: A read-only multitrack piano roll of a prepared timeline: ruler with cycle numbers, a section strip, pitched rows and a compact drum strip with General MIDI names. Sized by CSS (SVG paths stretched with preserveAspectRatio none, HTML labels in percent, no height prop); fit view samples to a note cap, detail view scrolls at 72px per cycle, culls to the viewport and follows the playhead unless the reader just scrolled or prefers reduced motion. The playhead is a leaf on a PlaybackClock moved by transform, so playback never re-renders the notes. Stale state dims it and says 'previous'. TimelineRollLegend adds swatches, mute/solo toggles (aria-pressed, 24px, Alt-click solo), channel numbers below 480px and an actions slot. Track colours are --uikit-track-1..8, starting at blue. Pure core beside it.

items.name: core-console-button
items.title: Console Button
items.description: The plain buttons of a console face on Base UI's Button and Toggle: ConsoleButton (text with an optional console icon), ConsoleIconButton (a square icon-only button named by its label, which is also its tooltip) and ConsoleToggle (aria-pressed on/off with an accent border when pressed). Three heights read from the face's --uikit-control-h-sm|md|lg variables (24, 28, 32px by default, 44px on a touch face), four variants (ghost, outline, primary, subtle), an optional ConsoleTooltip with a shortcut, and focusableWhenDisabled so a busy or refused button keeps focus with aria-disabled. Hover, focus and pressed colours come from its own hoisted stylesheet, with transitions only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

items.name: core-console-tooltip
items.title: Console Tooltip
items.description: A short visual label for a console control on Base UI's Tooltip, opening after a short hover delay and at once on keyboard focus, closing on Escape, blur or pointer leave. The child element itself is the trigger through Base UI's render prop, so it wraps any button without an extra element. The popup portals into the fullscreen element while a face is in browser fullscreen, carries the face's theme variables and an optional shortcut, stacks at --uikit-z-overlay, and fades only when motion is allowed.

items.name: core-info-tip
items.title: Info Tip
items.description: An (i) console icon button that opens help on Base UI's Popover, so touch, keyboard and screen-reader users can reach it: a click, a tap, Enter or Space opens a dialog named by the label and described by the help, focus moves in, and Escape or an outside press closes it and returns focus to the button. The button sits at the console control height, the popup portals into the fullscreen element in browser fullscreen, and InfoTipContent spaces rich help (paragraphs, lists, code, keys).

items.name: core-console-switch
items.title: Console Switch
items.description: An on/off switch sized for a console row on Base UI's Switch (role switch, aria-checked, a hidden form input, Space and Enter toggle it): a control-height hit area around a 28 by 16px track, outlined and muted when off, filled with the accent when on, with no true/false text. focusableWhenDisabled keeps a refused switch in the tab order with aria-disabled. Colours from its own hoisted stylesheet, motion only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

items.name: core-toggle-lane
items.title: Toggle Lane
items.description: A row of on/off cells for choosing several values from a range, such as the notes of a chord on a keyboard strip or the semitones of a set, on Base UI's ToggleGroup with multiple selection: one Tab stop, arrow keys, Home and End to move, Space or Enter to toggle, aria-pressed and a label on every cell. Cells are at least 24px wide and as wide as the face's small control height (44px on a touch face), black keys follow the accidental pitch classes unless told otherwise, markers under cells start groups, on cells use the neutral --uikit-value colour, and the lane scrolls sideways when it overflows. The selection maths sits in a pure core beside it.
